data.name: 上古传说
data.detailed_description: Ancient Legends is a large-scale action role-playing browser game inspired by ancient Chinese mythology. Although the player character begins as an ordinary person—unlike the Witch and Lich clans, who are born with immense magical power—they are devoted to cultivation and fearless in the face of danger. Blessed by the fortune of the Child of the Dao, they journey freely across the world and ultimately become the most unconventional seeker of enlightenment on the Primordial Continent. The game features a rich set of progression systems—such as Spirit Beasts, Mystic Treasures, Transformations, Realms, Rank Advancement, Divine Rings, Demon-Sealing Records, Incantations, Divine Pets, and more—delivering a truly distinctive cultivation-and-enlightenment experience.

data.short_description: Ancient Legends is a fantasy MMORPG with fast progression, gear farming, bosses, and idle-friendly automation. Play solo or with others, build your character, and power up through dungeons, events, and upgrades. Optional in-game purchases.
